title: Iimaanka Qarsoon ee Gudaha Derbiyada Qasriga
intro: Iyada oo ku dhex jirta maxkamad kali talis ah oo ay ka buuxaan shirqoollo iyo kibir, naf keli ah ayaa sir khatar ah haysa. Iyada oo ay ku hareeraysan yihiin awood iyo hanjabaado dil ah, addoonkan Alle ayaa daawanaya rasuul kaligiis taagan oo ka soo horjeeda boqortooyo. Marka aamusnaantu noqoto mid la-hawlgasha, waa in la sameeyaa go'aan geesinimo leh si loo sheego runta iyadoo halis weyn ku jirta shaqsiga.
clues: Waxaan ku noolaa dad awood badan oo isla weyn oo diidaya calaamadaha Alle.
Waxaan qariyay iimaankayga muddo ah intii kuwa hareerahayga jooga ay shirqool ka dhan ah ku hayeen rasuul.
Si cad ayaan u hadlay, anigoo leh: Ma qof ayaad dishaa sababtoo ah waxay dhahaan, Rabbigay waa Alle, iyadoo xujooyin cad ay yimaadeen?
Waxaan dadkayga uga digay masiirka ummadihii hore iyo Maalinta Wicitaannada Wadajirka ah.
Waxaan u sheegay in taliyaha aan u adeegay uu muujinayo ra'yi kooban oo keliya, haddana Aakhiro waa hoyga dhabta ah.
Waxaan iri: Dadkaygow, i raaca, aniguna waan idin hanuunin doonaa jidka toosan, Allena wuu iga badbaadiyey sharkii shirqoolkooda.

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
